key_insight: AHE-Beta proposes centering agent harness evolution on user requirements rather than benchmark scores alone. The provided abstract is truncated, so its full method and results cannot be confirmed.
problem_solved: Existing approaches can overlook implicit user expectations and interaction needs. Relying on a single evolution agent and benchmark-based selection can produce narrow fixes that improve test scores without addressing broader requirements.
method: Use explicit and implicit user requirements to guide harness development and validation.
Treat interaction needs as part of the engineering objective, rather than focusing only on benchmark performance.
Further implementation details and evaluation results are unavailable in the provided excerpt.
impact: For practitioners, the proposed framing encourages evaluating agent infrastructure against real user needs, not just benchmark gains. Its effectiveness remains unverified from the supplied excerpt.

paper_title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
